import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/training_3.csv"
]

# Corresponding years for each source file, based on the target schema pattern
# Source 0 -> 2013, Source 1 -> 2014, Source 2 -> 2015, Source 3 -> 2016
years = [2013, 2014, 2015, 2016]

# Read each source file into a DataFrame, rename columns to match target schema for that year
dfs = []
for file_path, year in zip(source_files, years):
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Rename columns: Wins -> '{year} Wins', Losses -> '{year} Losses', Draws -> '{year} Draws'
    df_renamed = df.rename(columns={
        'Wins': f'{year} Wins',
        'Losses': f'{year} Losses',
        'Draws': f'{year} Draws'
    })
    dfs.append(df_renamed)

# Merge all yearly DataFrames on 'Wrestler' using outer join to keep all wrestlers
# Start merging from the first year
merged_df = dfs[0]
for df in dfs[1:]:
    merged_df = pd.merge(merged_df, df, on='Wrestler', how='outer')

# Fill NaN values with 0 for all numeric columns (Wins, Losses, Draws)
# Wrestler column is string, so no fill needed there
numeric_cols = [col for col in merged_df.columns if col != 'Wrestler']
merged_df[numeric_cols] = merged_df[numeric_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match the target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Wrestler',
    '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
    '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
    '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
    '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws'
]

merged_df = merged_df[target_columns]

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/target_multisource_cot.csv"
merged_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns to match target schema for each year/source
# Source0 -> 2013 columns
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

# Source1 -> 2014 columns
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

# Source2 -> 2015 columns
df2_renamed = df2.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

# Source3 -> 2016 columns
df3_renamed = df3.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Join all four dataframes on 'Wrestler' using inner joins to keep only wrestlers present in all sources
df_joined = df0_renamed.merge(df1_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner') \
                       .merge(df2_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner') \
                       .merge(df3_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner')

# Group by Wrestler and sum all numeric columns to handle any duplicates
# (Though duplicates unlikely, this ensures unique rows as in target)
group_cols = ['Wrestler']
agg_cols = [col for col in df_joined.columns if col != 'Wrestler']

df_final = df_joined.groupby(group_cols, as_index=False)[agg_cols].sum()

# Write output with exact target schema column order
target_columns = ['Wrestler',
                  '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
                  '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
                  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
                  '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

df_final = df_final[target_columns]

df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_63/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
